REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 22, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 815 9318 3447
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public subject to Los Angeles County mandated COVID-19 protocols. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will also be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below, or in-person subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81593183447
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 815 9318 3447
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

This section is reserved for comments related to the Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and/or items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the legislative body, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a legislative body member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

Approval of Minutes

Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 77-50(2021) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY THE PROPERTY OWNER, HAITAI, LLC, TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST- AND SECOND-FLOOR OFFICE ADDITION AND AN INTERIOR REMODEL TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY INDUSTRIAL BUILDING AT 13151 MIDWAY PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. 11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
13.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
APRIL 22, 2021, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 815 9318 3447

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Hu.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Mayor Hu introduced newly appointed Cerritos City Attorney Bill Ihrke and welcomed him
  to the City.

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer, provided an update on the City’s public meeting schedule.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Bill Lam submitted written correspondence regarding the Metro NextGen Bus Plan.

  Audio public comments:

  Mel Cortez requested clarification of “public places” as related to the Art in Public Places in
  the Cerritos Municipal Code and inquired whether the Municipal Code will be augmented if
  distancing requirements are changed for drive-through service restaurants.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to
  speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, April 22, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Friday, April 2, 2021, 1:00 p.m. City Council Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Friday, April 2,
  2021, 1:00 p.m. City Council Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Tuesday, April 6, 2021, 10:00 a.m. City Council Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Tuesday, April
  6, 2021 10:00 a.m. City Council Special Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Thursday, April 8, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Thursday, April
  8, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 22, 2021 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  April 22, 2021  $ 3,871,027.64 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, April 22, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 6

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Recommendation by the Cerritos Planning Commission, on a vote of 5-0, to approve
  the following:

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 77-50(2021) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY THE
  PROPERTY OWNER, HAITAI, LLC, TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST AND SECOND-FLOOR OFFICE
  ADDITION AND AN INTERIOR REMODEL TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY INDUSTRIAL
  BUILDING AT 13151 MIDWAY PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE PROPOSED
  IMPROVEMENTS ALSO INCLUDE REFURBISHMENT OF THE EXISTING LANDSCAPING AND
  OTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT
  AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7005-005-083) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this
  project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments period. Noting there were no
  individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period and public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2021-06, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 77-50(2021) AMENDMENT, A REQUEST BY THE
  PROPERTY OWNER, HAITAI, LLC, TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST AND SECOND-FLOOR
  OFFICE ADDITION AND AN INTERIOR REMODEL TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY
  INDUSTRIAL BUILDING AT 13151 MIDWAY PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA,
  90703. THE PROPOSED IMPROVEMENTS ALSO INCLUDE REFURBISHMENT OF THE
  EXISTING LANDSCAPING AND OTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA ONE (ADP-1) (APN 7005-005-
  083) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the COVID-
  19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, April 22, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to receive and file the
  informational report on the City's response to the COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of an informational budget and audit compliance report for
  Fiscal Year 2020-21 (COUNCIL).

  Staff reports were given by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager, Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager,
  and Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works/Water and Power. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to include updates on the reopening of
  Parks and Recreation facilities in the COVID-19 informational report given at each City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to provide an agenda report related
  to establishing a policy for funding preventative maintenance work on City facilities and
  assets, inclusive of requirements for the maintenance of warranties, as part of the 2021-22
  budget study session process.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to receive and file the
  informational budget and audit compliance report for Fiscal Year 2020-21 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a contract for City Attorney and general municipal law services
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Torrey Contreras, Senior Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, April 22, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  MAIN MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Approve the agreement for contract general legal services with the firm of Rutan &
  Tucker, LLP, represented by William H. Ihrke who will be serving as Cerritos City
  Attorney, as amended to include the compensation amounts as listed in the Rutan &
  Tucker Request for Services Response, Section VIII Support Staff (page 23) in the
  Schedule of Compensation (Exhibit B of proposed agreement); and

  2. Authorize the Mayor/Chair to execute the subject agreement on behalf of the City of
  Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  SUBSTITUTE MOTION: A motion made by Councilmember Yokoyama, requesting the firm
  of Rutan & Tucker to amend their proposed agreement for contract legal services to a rate
  of $225 per hour, reported as being proposed by Aleshire & Wynder, failed due to lack of a
  second.

  FINAL MAIN MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Approve the agreement for contract general legal services with the firm of Rutan &
  Tucker, LLP, represented by William H. Ihrke who will be serving as Cerritos City
  Attorney, as amended to include the compensation amounts as listed in the Rutan &
  Tucker Request for Services Response, Section VIII Support Staff (page 23) in the
  Schedule of Compensation (Exhibit B of proposed agreement); and

  2. Authorize the Mayor/Chair to execute the subject agreement on behalf of the City of
  Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, April 22, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 6

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were given by Councilmembers Solanki and Barrows, Mayor Pro Tem Vo, and
  Mayor Hu.

  CONSENSUS (Solanki): Directed the City Manager to place an agenda report for review
  and consideration of the placement of artwork at the Cerritos Library on an upcoming
  public meeting agenda.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to place an agenda report related to
  definitions of “public places” in the Cerritos Municipal Code (Section 22.94.020) with regard
  to the placement of art through the Art in Public Places Program on an upcoming public
  meeting agenda.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to place an agenda report related to
  review and consideration of recommendations regarding public artwork for the City-owned
  building located at 12616 183rd Street on an upcoming public meeting agenda.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:17 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
